subject.title: [Bug]: Agent heartbeat routes to wrong agent's session instead of its own

question: Should maintainers accept the open fix path that sets heartbeat MsgContext.AgentId for global-scope secondary-agent heartbeats, or choose a different session identity boundary?
rationale: The source reproduction is clear, but the fix touches the session identity contract and already has a concrete open PR, so maintainer intent should settle the exact boundary before closure.

options.title: Review the open PR
options.body: Review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102307 as the narrow candidate fix and close this issue only after it lands with sufficient proof.

options.title: Ask for a broader identity refactor
options.body: Keep this issue open and redirect the PR if maintainers want heartbeat agent identity resolved earlier than MsgContext construction.

options.title: Reject per-agent identity under global scope
options.body: Close only if maintainers decide global-scope heartbeats should intentionally execute as the default agent despite the current report and docs expectation.

recommendation.title: Review the open PR
recommendation.body: Review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102307 as the narrow candidate fix and close this issue only after it lands with sufficient proof.
